## Exploratory Data Analysis

```{r}
#Data structure
glimpse(data_pilot)
summary(data_pilot)
colSums(is.na(data_pilot))

```

```{r}
# Prepare variables
data_pilot <- data_pilot %>%
  mutate(
    fish_id = factor(fish_id),

    treatment = factor(
      treatment,
      levels = c("NI", "PBS", "LPS")
    ),

    treatment_plot = factor(
      treatment,
      levels = c("NI", "PBS", "LPS"),
      labels = c("No injection", "PBS", "LPS")
    ),

    # Recalculate body-mass change from the original measurements
    mass_change_g = body_mass2 - body_mass1,

    mass_change_percent = (
      (body_mass2 - body_mass1) / body_mass1
    ) * 100,

    # Standardised pre-injection body mass
    body_mass_before_sc = as.numeric(scale(body_mass1))
  )

```

```{r}
# Check variable structure
str(data_pilot)

# Number of fish in each treatment
table(data_pilot$treatment)

# Check for missing values
colSums(is.na(data_pilot))

# Check the recalculated body-mass changes
head(
  data_pilot %>%
    dplyr::select(
      fish_id,
      treatment,
      body_mass1,
      body_mass2,
      mass_change_g,
      mass_change_percent
    )
)

```

```{r}
# Descriptive statistics by treatment
descriptive_statistics <- data_pilot %>%

    body_mass_after_mean = mean(body_mass2, na.rm = TRUE),
    body_mass_after_sd = sd(body_mass2, na.rm = TRUE),

    mass_change_mean = mean(mass_change_g, na.rm = TRUE),
    mass_change_sd = sd(mass_change_g, na.rm = TRUE),

    mass_change_percent_mean = mean(
      mass_change_percent,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    mass_change_percent_sd = sd(
      mass_change_percent,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    wbc_mean = mean(wbc, na.rm = TRUE),
    wbc_sd = sd(wbc, na.rm = TRUE),
    wbc_median = median(wbc, na.rm = TRUE),
    wbc_min = min(wbc, na.rm = TRUE),
    wbc_max = max(wbc, na.rm = TRUE),

    nl_ratio_mean = mean(nl_ratio, na.rm = TRUE),
    nl_ratio_sd = sd(nl_ratio, na.rm = TRUE),
    nl_ratio_median = median(nl_ratio, na.rm = TRUE),
    nl_ratio_min = min(nl_ratio, na.rm = TRUE),
    nl_ratio_max = max(nl_ratio, na.rm = TRUE),

    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

# Body mass - Analysis

```{r}
# Convert body mass data to long format
mass_long <- data_pilot %>%
  dplyr::select(
    fish_id,
    treatment,
    treatment_plot,
    body_mass1,
    body_mass2
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(body_mass1, body_mass2),
    names_to = "time",
    values_to = "body_mass"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    time = factor(
      time,
      levels = c("body_mass1", "body_mass2"),
      labels = c("Before", "After")
    )
  )

# Inspect the long-format dataset
head(mass_long, 10)

# Confirm the number of observations
dim(mass_long)

# Confirm that each fish has two measurements
table(table(mass_long$fish_id))

# Mean body mass by treatment and time
mass_long %>%
  group_by(treatment, time) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    mean = mean(body_mass, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd = sd(body_mass, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Log-transform body mass
mass_long <- mass_long %>%
  mutate(
    log_body_mass = log(body_mass)
  )

# Visualise the transformed variable
hist(
  mass_long$log_body_mass,
  main = "Log-transformed body mass",
  xlab = "log(body mass)",
  col = "grey80",
  border = "white"
)
```

```{r}
# Final log-transformed model retaining the interaction
m_mass_log_final <- lmer(
  log_body_mass ~ time * treatment + (1 | fish_id),
  data = mass_long,
  REML = TRUE
)

# Inspect the final model
summary(m_mass_log_final)

# Overall tests
anova(
  m_mass_log_final,
  type = 3
)
```

```{r}
# Simulated residuals
res_mass_log <- simulateResiduals(
  fittedModel = m_mass_log_final,
  n = 1000
)

# General diagnostic plot
plot(res_mass_log)

# Individual diagnostic tests
testUniformity(res_mass_log)

testDispersion(res_mass_log)

testOutliers(res_mass_log)

# Residuals by treatment
plotResiduals(
  res_mass_log,
  form = mass_long$treatment
)

# Residuals by time
plotResiduals(
  res_mass_log,
  form = mass_long$time
)
```


```{r}
# Final body-mass model
# Writing log() directly allows emmeans to back-transform the results
m_mass_log_final <- lmer(
  log(body_mass) ~ time * treatment + (1 | fish_id),
  data = mass_long,
  REML = TRUE
)

summary(m_mass_log_final)
```

```{r}
# Estimated marginal means for time within each treatment
emm_mass_log <- emmeans(
  m_mass_log_final,
  ~ time | treatment
)

# Results on the original body-mass scale
summary(
  emm_mass_log,
  type = "response"
)

# After-to-before ratio within each treatment
mass_change_log <- contrast(
  emm_mass_log,
  method = list(
    "After / Before" = c(-1, 1)
  )
)

# Back-transform the estimates into ratios
summary(
  mass_change_log,
  type = "response",
  infer = c(TRUE, TRUE),
  adjust = "sidak"
)
```

```{r}
# Convert ratios into percentage changes
mass_change_percent <- as.data.frame(
  summary(
    mass_change_log,
    type = "response",
    infer = c(TRUE, TRUE),
    adjust = "sidak"
  )
) %>%
  mutate(
    percent_change = (ratio - 1) * 100,
    lower_percent = (lower.CL - 1) * 100,
    upper_percent = (upper.CL - 1) * 100
  )

mass_change_percent
```

```{r}
# Direct comparisons among treatment-specific mass changes
mass_change_comparisons <- pairs(
  mass_change_log,
  by = NULL,
  reverse = TRUE,
  adjust = "tukey"
)

# Results on the response scale
summary(
  mass_change_comparisons,
  type = "response",
  infer = c(TRUE, TRUE)
)
```

```{r}
# Colour palette matching the main manuscript
pastel_cols <- c(
  "No injection" = "#A8D5BA",
  "PBS" = "#F9E79F",
  "LPS" = "#F5B7B1"
)

dark_cols <- c(
  "No injection" = "#2E8B57",
  "PBS" = "#C9A227",
  "LPS" = "#B22222"
)

# Estimated geometric means and 95% confidence intervals
emm_mass_plot <- as.data.frame(
  summary(
    emm_mass_log,
    type = "response"
  )
) %>%
  mutate(
    treatment_plot = factor(
      treatment,
      levels = c("NI", "PBS", "LPS"),
      labels = c("No injection", "PBS", "LPS")
    ),
    time = factor(
      time,
      levels = c("Before", "After")
    )
  )

# Prepare raw data for plotting
mass_long <- mass_long %>%
  mutate(
    treatment_plot = factor(
      treatment,
      levels = c("NI", "PBS", "LPS"),
      labels = c("No injection", "PBS", "LPS")
    ),
    time = factor(
      time,
      levels = c("Before", "After")
    )
  )

# Body-mass figure
p_mass_pilot <- ggplot(
  mass_long,
  aes(
    x = time,
    y = body_mass
  )
) +

  # Paired trajectories for each fish
  geom_line(
    aes(group = fish_id),
    colour = "grey50",
    alpha = 0.30,
    linewidth = 0.4
  ) +

  # Raw-data boxplots
  geom_boxplot(
    aes(fill = treatment_plot),
    width = 0.50,
    alpha = 0.25,
    colour = "black",
    outlier.shape = NA
  ) +

  # Individual observations
  geom_point(
    aes(colour = treatment_plot),
    position = position_jitter(
      width = 0.05,
      height = 0,
      seed = 123
    ),
    alpha = 0.60,
    size = 2
  ) +

  # Model-estimated geometric means and 95% CIs
  geom_errorbar(
    data = emm_mass_plot,
    aes(
      x = time,
      ymin = lower.CL,
      ymax = upper.CL,
      colour = treatment_plot
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    width = 0.10,
    linewidth = 1.1
  ) +

  geom_point(
    data = emm_mass_plot,
    aes(
      x = time,
      y = response,
      fill = treatment_plot
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    shape = 21,
    size = 4.5,
    stroke = 1.1,
    colour = "black"
  ) +

  facet_wrap(
    ~ treatment_plot,
    nrow = 1
  ) +

  scale_colour_manual(
    values = dark_cols
  ) +

  scale_fill_manual(
    values = pastel_cols
  ) +

  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(6),
    expand = expansion(
      mult = c(0.03, 0.07)
    )
  ) +

  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Body mass (g)"
  ) +

  theme_bw(
    base_size = 14
  ) +

  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none",
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(
      size = 14,
      face = "bold"
    ),
    axis.title = element_text(
      size = 15
    ),
    axis.text = element_text(
      size = 13,
      colour = "grey25"
    )
  )

p_mass_pilot

# Save as vector PDF
ggsave(
  here("figures", "pilot_body_mass.pdf"),
  p_mass_pilot,
  width = 8,
  height = 4.8
)

# Save as high-resolution JPEG
ggsave(
  here("figures", "pilot_body_mass.jpg"),
  p_mass_pilot,
  width = 8,
  height = 4.8,
  dpi = 600
)
```

# Immune response - Analysis
## WBC

```{r}
# WBC model
m_wbc <- glmmTMB(
  wbc ~ treatment + body_mass_before_sc,
  family = Gamma(link = "log"),
  data = data_pilot
)

# Inspect the model
summary(m_wbc)

# Overall tests of treatment and initial body mass
Anova(
  m_wbc,
  type = "II")
```

```{r}
# Simulate residuals from the WBC model
res_wbc <- simulateResiduals(
  fittedModel = m_wbc,
  n = 1000
)

# General diagnostic plot
plot(res_wbc)

# Test residual uniformity
testUniformity(res_wbc)

# Test overdispersion or underdispersion
testDispersion(res_wbc)

# Test for an unusual number of outliers
testOutliers(res_wbc)

# Residuals by treatment
plotResiduals(
  res_wbc,
  form = data_pilot$treatment
)

# Residuals in relation to initial body mass
plotResiduals(
  res_wbc,
  form = data_pilot$body_mass_before_sc
)

# Model convergence checks
m_wbc$fit$convergence

m_wbc$sdr$pdHess
```


```{r}
# Estimated marginal means for WBC
emm_wbc <- emmeans(
  m_wbc,
  ~ treatment,
  at = list(
    body_mass_before_sc = 0
  ),
  type = "response"
)

emm_wbc

# Tukey-adjusted pairwise comparisons
wbc_comparisons <- pairs(
  emm_wbc,
  reverse = TRUE,
  adjust = "tukey"
)

summary(
  wbc_comparisons,
  type = "response",
  infer = c(TRUE, TRUE)
)

```

```{r}
# Convert treatment ratios into percentage differences
wbc_comparisons_percent <- as.data.frame(
  summary(
    wbc_comparisons,
    type = "response",
    infer = c(TRUE, TRUE)
  )
) %>%
  mutate(
    percent_difference = (ratio - 1) * 100,
    lower_percent = (asymp.LCL - 1) * 100,
    upper_percent = (asymp.UCL - 1) * 100
  )

wbc_comparisons_percent
```

```{r}
# Tukey compact-letter display
wbc_letters <- multcomp::cld(
  emm_wbc,
  adjust = "tukey",
  Letters = letters,
  type = "response",
  sort = FALSE
) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  mutate(
    .group = trimws(.group),

    treatment_plot = factor(
      treatment,
      levels = c("NI", "PBS", "LPS"),
      labels = c("No injection", "PBS", "LPS")
    )
  )

wbc_letters

# Prepare estimated means and confidence intervals
emm_wbc_plot <- as.data.frame(
  summary(
    emm_wbc,
    type = "response"
  )
) %>%
  mutate(
    treatment_plot = factor(
      treatment,
      levels = c("NI", "PBS", "LPS"),
      labels = c("No injection", "PBS", "LPS")
    )
  )

# Find the highest raw value within each treatment
wbc_raw_max <- data_pilot %>%
  group_by(treatment_plot) %>%
  summarise(
    raw_max = max(wbc, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

wbc_letters_plot <- wbc_letters %>%
  dplyr::select(
    treatment,
    treatment_plot,
    asymp.UCL,
    .group
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    wbc_raw_max,
    by = "treatment_plot"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    letter_y = pmax(
      asymp.UCL,
      raw_max
    ) + 12
  )

wbc_letters_plot

# WBC boxplot with Tukey letters
p_wbc_pilot <- ggplot(
  data_pilot,
  aes(
    x = treatment_plot,
    y = wbc
  )
) +

  # Raw-data boxplots
  geom_boxplot(
    aes(fill = treatment_plot),
    width = 0.55,
    alpha = 0.25,
    colour = "black",
    outlier.shape = NA
  ) +

  # Individual fish
  geom_point(
    aes(colour = treatment_plot),
    position = position_jitter(
      width = 0.15,
      height = 0,
      seed = 123
    ),
    alpha = 0.60,
    size = 2
  ) +

  # Model-estimated means and 95% confidence intervals
  geom_errorbar(
    data = emm_wbc_plot,
    aes(
      x = treatment_plot,
      ymin = asymp.LCL,
      ymax = asymp.UCL,
      colour = treatment_plot
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    width = 0.20,
    linewidth = 1.1
  ) +

  # Model-estimated means
  geom_point(
    data = emm_wbc_plot,
    aes(
      x = treatment_plot,
      y = response,
      fill = treatment_plot
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    shape = 21,
    size = 4.5,
    stroke = 1.1,
    colour = "black"
  ) +

  # Tukey significance letters
  geom_text(
    data = wbc_letters_plot,
    aes(
      x = treatment_plot,
      y = letter_y,
      label = .group
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 5,
    fontface = "bold",
    colour = "black"
  ) +

  scale_colour_manual(
    values = dark_cols
  ) +

  scale_fill_manual(
    values = pastel_cols
  ) +

  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(7),
    expand = expansion(
      mult = c(0, 0.10)
    )
  ) +

  expand_limits(
    y = c(
      0,
      max(wbc_letters_plot$letter_y) + 5
    )
  ) +

  labs(
    x = "Injection treatment",
    y = "Total white blood cells"
  ) +

  theme_bw(
    base_size = 14
  ) +

  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.title = element_text(
      size = 15
    ),
    axis.text = element_text(
      size = 13,
      colour = "grey25"
    )
  )

p_wbc_pilot

# Save WBC figure
ggsave(
```

## Neutrophil/lymphocyte ratio

```{r}
# N:L ratio model
m_nl <- glmmTMB(
  nl_ratio ~ treatment + body_mass_before_sc,
  family = Gamma(link = "log"),
  data = data_pilot
)

# Inspect the model
summary(m_nl)

# Overall tests of treatment and initial body mass
Anova(
  m_nl,
  type = "II"
)

```

```{r}
set.seed(123)

# Simulate scaled residuals from the N:L ratio model
res_nl <- DHARMa::simulateResiduals(
  fittedModel = m_nl,
  n = 1000
)

# General diagnostic plot
plot(res_nl)

# Formal diagnostic tests
DHARMa::testUniformity(res_nl)
DHARMa::testDispersion(res_nl)
DHARMa::testOutliers(res_nl)

# Residuals by treatment
DHARMa::plotResiduals(
  res_nl,
  form = data_pilot$treatment
)

# Residuals in relation to initial body mass
DHARMa::plotResiduals(
  res_nl,
  form = data_pilot$body_mass_before_sc
)
```

```{r}
# Estimated marginal means for each treatment
# body_mass_before_sc is held at its mean, which is zero after scaling
emm_nl <- emmeans::emmeans(
  m_nl,
  ~ treatment,
  type = "response"
)

# Display estimated means on the original N:L-ratio scale
summary(
  emm_nl,
  type = "response",
  infer = c(TRUE, TRUE)
)

# Pairwise treatment comparisons with Tukey adjustment
nl_comparisons <- emmeans::contrast(
  emm_nl,
  method = "pairwise",
  adjust = "tukey"
)

# Display comparisons as ratios
summary(
  nl_comparisons,
  type = "response",
  infer = c(TRUE, TRUE)
)

```

```{r}
# Obtain compact-letter display from Tukey comparisons
nl_letters <- multcomp::cld(
  emm_nl,
  adjust = "tukey",
  Letters = letters,
  type = "response",
  sort = FALSE

    )

nl_letters

  dplyr::group_by(treatment_plot) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    raw_max = max(nl_ratio, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


# Prepare model estimates and positions for the letters
nl_letters_plot <- nl_letters %>%
  dplyr::select(
    treatment,
    treatment_plot,
    response,
    asymp.LCL,
    asymp.UCL,
    .group
  ) %>%

    nl_raw_max,
    by = "treatment_plot"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    letter_y = pmax(
      asymp.UCL,

    ) + 0.035
  )


# Check the final plotting table
nl_letters_plot
```
